name: Chaos Computer Club Event Network
notes:
The Event Network of the Chaos Computer Club only operates on a temporary basis. Events like Chaos Communitcation Congress, Chaos Communication Camp, Gulasch Programmier Nacht or Easterhegg are using this network for a few days within the year.

We sometimes appear at IXPs but mostly behind sponsored transits for a short time frame.

If you want to donate transit to the those events, please contact noc@ccc.de
